correctness.rationale: The pair-count identity implies the mod-g state constraint. All admissible triples are reachable by exhausting the 01 count interval at fixed positive multiples-of-m letter counts. Every admissible suffix count-and-imbalance triple is realizable by the same interval argument. Three explicit suffix letter-count residues force three independent affine constraints on a state difference, hence Myhill–Nerode separation. Verified direct counting, minimization, and 14,381 explicit suffix separators via the embedded standalone code. The code is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
